g.text: Each dot is one Israeli locality: its 2022 vote balance between the Netanyahu coalition and the opposition (left–right),
and how much its turnout changed from the 2022 to the 2026 Knesset election (up–down). Bars show each group's median.
Coalition: Likud, Religious Zionism, Shas, United Torah Judaism. Opposition: Yesh Atid, National Unity, Yisrael Beiteinu, Labor, Meretz. Arab-party and other votes are excluded from the balance.

Gray: an Arab party (Ra'am, Hadash–Ta'al or Balad) was the single most-voted list in 2022; horizontal position in that panel carries no meaning. Turnout = votes ÷ eligible voters at the locality's ballot boxes
(double envelopes excluded). Sources: Central Elections Committee 2022 final results; 2026 22:00 election-day turnout report by ballot box (preliminary, not final). n = 1,215 localities.
